catalog_provenance: Original Project-SKRIPSI editorial templates; no third-party phrase inventory copied.

patterns.template_id_text: Dalam konteks [setting], [problem] tampak pada [evidence], sehingga penelitian ini berfokus pada [scope].
patterns.template_en_text: In [setting], [problem] is reflected in [evidence]; this study therefore focuses on [scope].
patterns.caution: Replace placeholders only with verified context and local evidence.

patterns.template_id_text: Sejumlah penelitian melaporkan [shared finding], sementara perbedaan pada [population/method/context] membatasi keterbandingan hasilnya.
patterns.template_en_text: Several studies report [shared finding], while differences in [population/method/context] limit direct comparison.
patterns.caution: Do not imply consensus from one source or from inaccessible full texts.

patterns.template_id_text: Pada sumber yang ditelaah, aspek [specific aspect] belum dibahas secara memadai dalam konteks [bounded context].
patterns.template_en_text: Within the sources reviewed, [specific aspect] has not been adequately addressed in [bounded context].
patterns.caution: A research gap is bounded to the search strategy and corpus actually reviewed.

patterns.template_id_text: Hasil menunjukkan adanya hubungan antara [variable A] dan [variable B] pada [population/context] dalam data yang dianalisis.
patterns.template_en_text: The analyzed data show an association between [variable A] and [variable B] in [population/context].
patterns.caution: Association is not causation; state the design and uncertainty.

patterns.template_id_text: Temuan ini dapat mengindikasikan [interpretation], tetapi penjelasan tersebut perlu dibaca dengan mempertimbangkan [limitation].
patterns.template_en_text: This finding may indicate [interpretation], although that explanation should be considered alongside [limitation].
patterns.caution: Interpretation must not exceed the measured variables or design.

patterns.template_id_text: Temuan ini berbeda dari [source/case] pada [dimension]; perbedaan tersebut mungkin berkaitan dengan [documented contextual difference].
patterns.template_en_text: This finding differs from [source/case] in [dimension]; the difference may relate to [documented contextual difference].
patterns.caution: Only name a contextual explanation when the source supports it.

patterns.template_id_text: Hasil penelitian perlu ditafsirkan dengan memperhatikan [specific limitation], yang membatasi [scope of inference].
patterns.template_en_text: The findings should be interpreted in light of [specific limitation], which constrains [scope of inference].
patterns.caution: Name the actual limitation and explain which inference it constrains.

patterns.template_id_text: Dalam batas [population/time/design], penelitian ini menemukan [direct result] untuk menjawab [research question].
patterns.template_en_text: Within the limits of [population/time/design], this study found [direct result] in response to [research question].
patterns.caution: Conclusions must map to reported results, not expected outcomes.

patterns.template_id_text: Penelitian berikutnya dapat menguji [specific unresolved issue] dengan [method/data] untuk menilai apakah temuan ini berlaku pada [new scope].
patterns.template_en_text: Future research could examine [specific unresolved issue] using [method/data] to assess whether the finding extends to [new scope].
patterns.caution: Recommendations are proposals, not claims that an intervention will work.
